entries.zh: 事物的本性；体质、体度
entries.en: the nature of a thing; its inherent substance and measure.
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节 ū̃ 与「度」对音不合，字形或音写存疑；R 栏空。

entries.zh: 事物的本性、本事（本来面目）
entries.en: the nature of a thing; what it really is.
entries.notes: H 栏「本寺」于义不合，疑为「本事」之讹或另有所指；R 栏空，仅据西语词头与音写推断。

entries.zh: 天然的能、本能；事物的本性功能
entries.en: natural faculty or capacity; the inherent function of a thing.
entries.notes: M 栏 ēng 与「能」对音不合、反近「用」，字形或音写存疑；R 栏空。

entries.zh: 心体；心的本体、天然禀性
entries.en: the natural constitution of the heart or mind; inborn disposition.
entries.notes: 以「心体」对应 natural de la cosa 属推断；R 栏空。

entries.zh: 生性偏颇；天生的性向偏好
entries.en: natural inclination; a leaning or bias of disposition.

entries.zh: 性情；天生的情感与气质
entries.en: natural disposition; affections and passions; temperament.

entries.zh: 依然；一如本来、照旧
entries.en: as it naturally is; unchanged, of one's own nature.
entries.notes: 「依然」与 natural propio（固有本性）对应较松，依赖推断；R 栏空。

entries.zh: 性直；天性直率耿直
entries.en: good-natured; straightforward and upright by nature.

entries.zh: 慷慨；天性大方
entries.en: generous, open-handed by nature.

entries.zh: 使性；任性使气、动辄发脾气
entries.en: bad-tempered; willful, given to fits of temper.
entries.notes: M 栏杂入西语残词 malo，音写欠净；「使性」当 natural malo（坏脾气）贴合。

entries.zh: 不本分；不安分、逾越本分
entries.en: ill-natured; not keeping to one's proper station.

entries.zh: 执偏；固执偏邪、性情乖僻
entries.en: perverse; obstinately crooked or biased by nature.
entries.notes: 词头 auieso 按十七世纪拼写（u=v）归一为 avieso（乖僻、邪僻）。

entries.zh: 使侥幸；亏待人、占人便宜
entries.en: to wrong or take unfair advantage of others; offensive, mistreating.
entries.notes: M 栏末音节 azauna 无法释读；agrauia 按 agraviar（亏负人）归一推断。

entries.zh: 剃刀；剃头（理发匠）
entries.en: razor (navaja); or barber (barbero).
entries.notes: H 栏第二字 [疑:頭/刀]；M 栏 quian 与两候选字对音均不合，音写存疑。

entries.zh: 剃头刀；剃刀
entries.en: razor for shaving the head.

entries.zh: 船只的量词（疑为「隻」，今作「只」）
entries.en: numeral classifier for boats/ships (under nave, navío).
entries.notes: H 栏「婁」与 M 栏 chia 对音不合（chia 近「隻」），释义据词头 nave/navío/numeral 及音写推断。

entries.zh: 船；船只
entries.en: boat; ship.
entries.notes: L 栏空缺（西语词头无存）；R 栏 cun pou 之 pou 语义不明。

entries.zh: 艇；轻快小船
entries.en: boat; small vessel.

entries.zh: 舰；大战船、兵船
entries.en: large ship; man-of-war.

entries.zh: 鸟船；闽式小船（音写后二音节不明）
entries.en: small ship or craft; a Fujian-style 'bird' junk.
entries.notes: H 栏首字 [疑:鳥/舃] 且仅一字对 M 栏四音节；chiàu chūn 合「鸟船」，chīn chis 无法释读。
